rules.statement: Persons claiming the right of pre-emption under section 2(1)(b) must first satisfy that they would be heirs of the intending vendor if he should then die intestate, and also satisfy that they are descendants, ascendants or collaterals within the third degree of succession.
rules.supporting_quote: "Only in this way can full effect be given to all the words of section 2 (1) (b) and section 2 (2)."
